title: M/s Shree Behari Forgings Pvt. Ltd. v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf and Prashant Kumar, JJ.
disposition: Petition dismissed following Dev Prayag; additional-security demand not bad.
headnote: Allahabad High Court dismissed a writ seeking to quash a distribution licensee's additional-security demand under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, applying its earlier holding in M/s Dev Prayag Paper Mill that such a demand is not bad.
facts: The petitioner, an industrial consumer, challenged a 22 May 2014 demand notice issued by Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. for additional security under paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 7 July 2014 a Division Bench stayed the demand and tagged the writ with similar petitions. When the matter was heard in 2025, counsel informed the Court that the same additional-security issue had already been decided against consumers in M/s Dev Prayag Paper Mill (Pvt.) Ltd. v. State of U.P.

holding_units.holding: Following M/s Dev Prayag Paper Mill (Pvt.) Ltd. v. State of U.P., a demand of additional security by the distribution licensee under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is not bad, and a writ seeking to quash that demand is dismissed.
